shared_or_similar_visual_information: Multiple filled pieces separated by unfilled parts of the surrounding figure. On the left, use the gray portions of the inscribed circles near A and B, including the gray wedge at P. On the right, use the four light-blue sectors at the corners of the square.
mathematical_meanings: Left image: The fill picks out multiple parts of the small circles and excludes the surrounding white parts. Right image: The coloring selects the four quarter disks while excluding the white center.
Rationales: In each figure the fill specifies the components included in a total area. The unfilled pieces do not contribute to that total.
